decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the surface of the car park hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - No development of the new garage building with toilet facilities shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the building hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works and lighting have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include proposed car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material and details of lighting to the car park.  Soft landscape works shall include planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the use as a car park hereby permitted is commenced.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 8 - The access doorways to the disabled toilet shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level, and two parking spaces shall be retained for people with impaired mobility at all times.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of new garage with toilet facilities and creation of car park with 47 spaces (Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area)
